name: How long does a site feasibility consultation take?
description: An on-site consultation typically takes 1-2 hours, with follow-up research and a summary report provided within a week.

mainEntity.name: How long does a site feasibility consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a site feasibility consultation can vary depending on the property's complexity and the specific questions or challenges identified. Typically, an on-site visit and initial discussion might take 1-2 hours. Following the visit, additional time is spent on research into local regulations and utilities. You can expect to receive a summary report or detailed feedback within a few days to a week after the initial assessment.
